177c2cb8-8eb3-47c0-8cb0-3144b0b93184.description: A feature model must own at least one feature.

cb3d8983-491b-4bdf-9e94-3f56c9deedc6.description: A feature model must have a root feature.

4193a939-907b-4a11-bfae-166bc269b92d.description: The root must be one of the features owned by the model.

20f0ea37-c42c-460b-a67a-3db6fb171001.description: the root feature cannot have a parent.

bc5ab2c9-40a5-4340-957d-5e97d95c9432.description: No two features in the same model may share the same id.

d031c0f3-5a8c-4031-bef9-f210983ab75e.description: A feature without a parent must be the model's root, every other feature needs a parent.
d031c0f3-5a8c-4031-bef9-f210983ab75e.constraint: context Feature inv OnlyRootHasNoParent: self.parent->isEmpty() implies self.featuremodel.root=self

9e4abe3d-15d9-4a8c-afd7-a7a53cccf332.description: A feature's parent must belong to the same feature model.
9e4abe3d-15d9-4a8c-afd7-a7a53cccf332.constraint: context Feature inv ParentInSameModel: self.parent->notEmpty() implies self.parent.featuremodel = self.featuremodel

0c961563-4e5d-4c18-a683-1b3d8706ed7e.description: An Xor group must have at least two members.
0c961563-4e5d-4c18-a683-1b3d8706ed7e.constraint: context GroupFeature inv XorAtLeastTwo: self.oclIsTypeOf(Xor) implies self.members->size() >= 2

90f5b81b-3df6-4f04-9b83-e077db9ba5d0.description: An Or group must have at least one members.
90f5b81b-3df6-4f04-9b83-e077db9ba5d0.constraint: context GroupFeature inv OrAtLeastOne: self.oclIsTypeOf(Or) implies self.members->size() >= 1

ba026543-f339-43d1-8ed8-260e060f82bf.description: Every member of a group must be a child of the group's parent feature.
ba026543-f339-43d1-8ed8-260e060f82bf.constraint: context GroupFeature inv MembersAreChildren: self.members->forAll(m | m.parent = self.parent)

85a13ab4-b42c-422e-9d87-062cb7093129.description: The source and target of a constraint must be different features.
85a13ab4-b42c-422e-9d87-062cb7093129.constraint: context CrossTreeConstraint inv Differentfeatures: self.source <> self.target

954c7e55-d3c3-4ded-a14a-615f4e358c20.description: Source and target must both belong to the model that owns the constraint.
954c7e55-d3c3-4ded-a14a-615f4e358c20.constraint: context CrossTreeConstraint inv SameModel: self.source.featuremodel = self.featuremodel and self.target.featuremodel = self.featuremodel

83af2288-f145-4985-a8bb-3aa1e88c8499.description: The chosen feature must belong to the model of its selection request.
83af2288-f145-4985-a8bb-3aa1e88c8499.constraint: context FeatureChoice inv FeatureInRequestModel: self.feature.featuremodel = self.selectionrequest.featuremodel

197a29fe-a6c6-426e-bf73-cda22f80bd28.description: The root feature cannot be mandatory, it has no parent
197a29fe-a6c6-426e-bf73-cda22f80bd28.constraint: context FeatureModel inv RootNotMandatory: self.root.isMandatory = false

846e2fd1-1596-46ab-824a-cb62a2bd066c.description: A feature id cannot be empty
846e2fd1-1596-46ab-824a-cb62a2bd066c.constraint: context Feature inv IdNotEmpty: self.id->notEmpty() and self.id.size() > 0

17cf218f-4991-4d7c-80bd-dfbf46a2eba0.description: Members of an Or/Xor group cannot be mandatory.
17cf218f-4991-4d7c-80bd-dfbf46a2eba0.constraint: context GroupFeature inv GroupMembersNotMandatory: self.members->forAll(m | m.isMandatory=false)

b037c0b8-ca64-46ad-8e72-16c50a71055b.description: The feature hierarchy cannot contain cycles.

ccb00cd9-dbae-4519-931f-06bf67ebb3a6.description: Need to have at least one variable

8aba06bc-a799-42ff-816c-df984ff283dc.description: Variables names must be unique within the same formula.

0c42fe27-5933-44a7-a754-82b8afb4cf3a.description: Each variable must map to a unique qubit register position.

aede7ca2-ebe8-47f9-8fa9-fc7cf2e54ef4.description: Clause identifiers must be unique within the formula.

e75d7625-1225-417b-8290-134d2441b90e.description: Variable name cannot be null or empty.
e75d7625-1225-417b-8290-134d2441b90e.constraint: context Variable inv NameNotEmpty: self.name->notEmpty() and self.name.size()>0

f275fc02-1cc5-4ddf-b932-6b687d059ed5.description: The qubit position must be a non-negative in the quantum register.

72c4da4a-8655-4ec5-b4c2-0a432b89a13e.description: Clause identifier cannot be null or empty.
72c4da4a-8655-4ec5-b4c2-0a432b89a13e.constraint: context Clause inv IdNotEmpty: self.id ->notEmpty() and self.id.size() >0

807edf1b-bf64-440b-a58f-d4af3f809bbb.description: A clause must not contain duplicate literals for the same variable

8376239d-afd1-49ea-827b-7ca2ee60748f.description: All literals contained in a clause must reference variables defined within the same CnfFormula.

a27e87c1-ea5d-4d8b-b2ec-b82dcd8bfc4b.constraint:
context SolverConfig inv PositiveExecutionParams:
self.rounds>0 and self.shots>0

ab3bdd7d-190d-433c-b994-7e19a4158190.description: the number of known solutions provided to the oracle must be non-negative.

75518d98-f5ae-4416-9202-83bc05f19732.description: A formula must contain at least one clause.

ef0c2b71-1780-45bb-8453-c6c5e7cd8e72.constraint: context CnfFormula inv ContigousIndexes: self.variables->forAll (v | v.index<self.variables->size())

aae25294-f52d-4bec-b287-067fb3dac959.description: Known solutions cannot exceed 2^n, where n is the number of variables.

6519edb0-b31e-444a-a083-0b57087cabdf.description: A formula can have at most 12 variables
